## RSV notification rates by LGA and year of diagnosis, 2023–2025

Use the year selector in the upper-right corner of the map to switch between 2023, 2024 and 2025.

Use the mouse, trackpad or map controls to zoom and pan. Hover over an LGA to view its notification count, population and notification rate.
